info.title: Octo Drive API
info.description: Drive spaces, file tree, blob upload/download, online-document mounts, shares, invites and IM transfer. The same business surface is served under a bot mount and a user-API-key mount; the CLI picks one from the active credential's token kind (x-octo-mount-by-token-kind), so every command works unchanged as a bot (bf_/app_) or as a real person (uk_).

name.description: shared space display name (UTF-8, 255 bytes max)

parameters.description: 1-based page number; currently only shapes the response page envelope

parameters.name: parent_id
parameters.description: parent folder id; 0 is the space root

parameters.name: page_index
parameters.description: 1-based page number for the response page envelope

parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description: page size for the response page envelope

200.description: Directory listing. entries is the complete result set; page is an envelope, not a database page.

post.summary: Full-text search files, folders and mounted documents across the caller's drive spaces
post.description: Full-text search over the caller's visible drive. Matches file/folder names and blob/doc bodies (OCR/extracted text) via OpenSearch, gated by the spaces the caller is a member of. Same command for a real person (uk_, routed to /v1/user/drive/search) and a bot (bf_/app_, routed to /v1/bot/drive/search); results are always scoped to what the active identity's uid can see, so a bot only sees spaces it was added to. Scalar request fields use flags; advanced filtering is a nested `filters` object in the request JSON supplied with --data, not a separate --filters flag. Requires the drive search backend (OpenSearch) to be configured on the server, otherwise it returns 503 unavailable.

q.description: full-text query; matches names (weighted higher) and blob/doc bodies. Required and non-empty.

scope.description: search radius: all visible spaces (default) or one space (requires --space-id)

space_id.description: drive space id to restrict to; required when --scope=space, ignored otherwise

page_size.description: page size (server caps to its max, default max 50)

filters.description: Advanced search filters, nested under filters in the request JSON passed with --data. Example: --data '{"filters":{"types":["blob"],"owner_scope":"me"}}'.

types.description: Include only these node types; absent or empty means no type restriction.

owner_scope.description: Filter by whether the caller owns the item; omitted, empty, or null means no ownership restriction.

updated_after.description: Match items updated at or after this RFC3339 timestamp.

size_min.description: Minimum size in bytes; null means no lower bound. Must not exceed size_max when both are supplied.

size_max.description: Maximum size in bytes; null means no upper bound. Must be at least size_min when both are supplied.

200.description: Search results. total is a lower-bound estimate of the union across the name and body indexes; truncated=true means the visible-doc set or an index page hit an internal cap and some body hits may be missing.

post.summary: Rename any file-tree node
Register an existing object-storage key as a blob (low-level)
post.description: Compatibility endpoint for objects already in storage. New uploads should use `drive upload file`, which runs prepare → PUT → confirm. The backend VERIFIES the object: an object_path storage does not hold is rejected with invalid_argument, and a `size` that conflicts with the stored object's is rejected too. A row created here carries no persisted download URL, so `share download` on it reports not_found — use `drive upload file` when you need a shareable blob.

object_path.description: object-storage key (not a URL). Must already be in storage — the backend probes it and rejects a key it cannot find

size.description: exact byte count; the backend compares it against the stored object and rejects a mismatch when storage discloses a length. 0 is a stated value, not an omission — pass the real count

post.summary: Create a pending file and get presigned PUT parameters (low-level)
post.description: Step 1 of 3. `drive upload file` runs the whole sequence; use this only when driving the PUT yourself. The PUT must echo content_type (and content_disposition when present) and send exactly max_file_size bytes, with no Authorization header.

parameters.name: X-Drive-Upload-Capabilities
parameters.description: set to multipart-v1 to declare multipart upload support; required only when the server selects multipart for an eligible large file

size.description: exact byte count; signed into the presigned URL

content_type.description: MIME type; must be echoed on the PUT

post.summary: Confirm a pending upload after the object PUT succeeded (low-level)

actual_size.description: bytes actually uploaded; must match the prepared size when supplied

post.summary: Cancel a pending upload (idempotent, low-level)

204.description: Cancelled; repeating the call also succeeds

post.summary: Get presigned URLs for a batch of multipart upload parts (low-level)
post.description: Request at most 20 one-based part numbers at a time. Each URL is short-lived and intended only for the corresponding object-storage PUT; never log it or include it in error messages. The optional response part_size is for re-signing alignment only: use the part_size from prepare-upload as the authoritative value.

upload_id.description: multipart upload id returned by prepare-upload; this is not a credential

part_numbers.description: one-based part numbers to sign, with at most 20 entries per request

url.description: short-lived presigned PUT URL; never log it or include it in error output

expires_at.description: per-part expiry; the only client signal that this part URL must be re-signed

part_size.description: optional server part size in bytes for re-sign alignment; the server has already converted KiB to bytes, so the client slices by bytes directly and must not convert again; prepare-upload remains authoritative

post.summary: Complete and verify a multipart upload (idempotent, low-level)
post.description: Submit the uploaded parts in ascending part_number order. Repeating this operation for the same upload_id is idempotent. The response size is the object size verified by the server after completing the upload.

upload_id.description: multipart upload id returned by prepare-upload; this is not a credential

part_number.description: one-based part number, ordered ascending for complete

etag.description: object-storage ETag returned by the part PUT

200.description: Completed and verified; repeating the call for the same upload_id also succeeds

size.description: object size verified by the server after completion

post.summary: Abort an incomplete multipart upload (idempotent, low-level)
post.description: Repeating this operation for the same upload_id is idempotent. If completion already won, the server returns upload_session_not_active; do not retry the same upload_id.

upload_id.description: multipart upload id returned by prepare-upload; this is not a credential

200.description: Aborted; repeating the call for the same upload_id also succeeds

ok.description: true when the incomplete multipart upload is not active

get.summary: Get a short-lived signed download URL for a blob (low-level)
get.description: Returns the URL only. `drive download file` fetches the bytes with a credential-free client and writes them atomically.

post.summary: Mount an accessible online document into the drive
post.description: The title and the document's real Octo Space are read server-side from the document metadata by doc_id; a client-supplied doc_title is ignored.

doc_id.description: document id from drive doc candidates

source.description: origin tag; octo-drive's allowedMountSources accepts both (user-upload / im-transfer are Type-2 only and are rejected)

get.summary: List mounted online documents in one directory

delete.summary: Remove a document mount; the document itself is untouched

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: mount node id (NOT the doc id)

get.summary: List documents the caller may mount that are not yet mounted here

post.summary: Create a blob share token (low-level)
post.description: Prefer `drive share create`, which detects blob vs document and returns a ready-to-hand-over share_url. This is the raw token API for automation that manages passwords, expiry, or revocation directly; the CLI leaf takes <file-id> positionally.

permission.description: what the receiver may do. When the field is omitted the backend stores view (preview only; share download then fails with permission_denied). The hand-written `drive share blob-create` command always sends --permission, which defaults to download.

expires_in_seconds.description: 0 uses the backend default (7 days); negative values are rejected

password.description: optional share password; hand it over out of band, never in the URL

get.summary: List the shares the caller created

delete.summary: Revoke a share; access and download stop working immediately

parameters.name: share_id
parameters.description: share_id from share create / share list. Marked x-octo-secret because the backend returns one opaque id that is both the management handle and the access token, so this value is credential-equivalent today; masking it costs only a masked id in output if a future rotation splits the two. base64url ids may start with "-", which cobra would read as a flag: pass --share-id <id>, or put the value after a "--" separator

post.summary: Resolve a blob share by its token (low-level; requires a verified identity)
post.description: The CLI leaf `drive share access` takes the whole share URL and parses this token out of it. Authentication is always required — there is no anonymous share surface.

parameters.name: share_token
parameters.description: share token parsed out of the share URL

password.description: share password when the share is password-protected

post.summary: Get the object URL for a shared blob (low-level; requires a verified identity)
post.description: The CLI leaf `drive share download` takes the whole share URL, calls this endpoint, then writes the bytes to disk. Authentication is always required — there is no anonymous share surface.

parameters.name: share_token
parameters.description: share token parsed out of the share URL

password.description: share password when the share is password-protected

post.summary: Create a shared-space invite (admin+)

parameters.name: invite_id
parameters.description: invite_id (NOT the invite_token). base64url ids may start with "-": pass --invite-id <id>, or put the value after a "--" separator

post.summary: Accept an invite as the current identity (idempotent)

parameters.name: invite_token
parameters.description: invite_token from invite create / invite list. base64url tokens may start with "-": pass --invite-token <token>, or put the value after a "--" separator

200.description: Accepted; already_member=true means the identity was already in the space

post.summary: Save an IM attachment into the drive (idempotent)

im_group_no.description: group/channel id from octo-cli message search files

im_channel_type.description: channel kind of the source message: 1=DM, 2=group, 5=thread. Required, and it must be the kind the message actually came from, for two reasons. (1) It picks the upstream message-read route: 1 uses the person/DM route, while 2 and 5 share the group route (group vs sub-thread is chosen by the composite group_no, not by this field), so 1 vs 2/5 resolves a different message or nothing. (2) It is stored as the first segment of the row's source_key (channelType#channelID#msgID), which blobs/im-transferred/batch matches on — a wrong value makes that already-transferred lookup miss the row. It is NOT the transfer idempotency key: that is (target space, type=blob, object path), so a wrong value cannot produce a duplicate file.

im_msg_id.description: message id as a string — never a JSON number, which would lose precision

200.description: Idempotent replay — a pre-existing row is returned with idempotent=true

get.summary: Probe the drive mount and report the verified caller identity
get.description: Connectivity and identity check. Only the mount's auth middleware runs (verify-bot for bf_/app_ on /v1/bot/drive, verify-api-key for uk_ on /v1/user/drive); no drive data is read. app_ tokens are rejected by verify-bot with 401.

uid.description: verified caller uid (the bot uid on the bot mount)

space_id.description: Octo Space bound to the credential during verification (NOT a drive space id)

get.summary: List the folder path from the space root to a node's parent
get.description: Root-first chain of folders above the node; the node itself is not included and a root-level node returns an empty list. Any live member of the node's drive space may read it. A pending or unknown node returns not_found. The walk stops early (partial chain) when a parent is missing, not a folder, or in another space.

get.summary: Check whether a mounted document still exists in the docs backend
get.description: Read-only probe for a type=doc node; it never changes the drive entry. Any live member of the node's drive space may call it. A non-doc node reports source_doc_missing. A docs backend failure is returned as an internal error rather than a missing status.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: mount node id (the drive file id, NOT the doc id)

alive.description: true only when status is alive

post.summary: Mount an online document after checking the caller's docs-backend admin role
post.description: Same request and response as `drive doc mount` (POST /docs), but the document-side check asks docs-backend for the caller's role rank and requires admin. The principal Octo Space for that check is taken from the X-Space-Id header verbatim (this route has no space gate, so the header is not verified against the credential); an empty header fails closed. The caller also needs editor or higher in the destination drive space. A document already mounted in the same drive space returns conflict.

parameters.name: X-Space-Id
parameters.description: the caller's Octo Space id used as the principal for the docs-backend role check (NOT the drive space id)

source.description: origin tag: user-mount (default) or docs-sync; the backend rejects anything else with invalid_argument

post.summary: Check which IM attachments are already saved in the caller's drive spaces
post.description: Looks each IM message up by its source key (channelType#channelID#msgID) across every drive space the caller belongs to in its verified Octo Space; personal wins over shared, then the most recently updated. Items with an empty im_group_no or im_msg_id are skipped, duplicates are collapsed, and only the first 100 distinct keys are checked. As a side effect the caller's personal drive space is created if it does not exist yet.

items.description: IM messages to check, pass via --data

im_group_no.description: channel id of the source message

im_channel_type.description: channel kind of the source message (1=DM, 2=group, 5=thread); must match the value used at transfer time

200.description: Hits keyed by source key; messages not saved anywhere are absent

post.summary: Save a copy of a shared blob into a drive space
post.description: Validates the share token, expiry and password like share access, then inserts a fresh copy of the blob (every call creates a new copy). Membership in the source space is not required. The caller needs uploader_downloader or higher in the target space; an omitted target_space_id saves into the caller's personal space root in its verified Octo Space. Only blob shares transfer.

parameters.name: share_token
parameters.description: share token parsed out of the share URL. base64url tokens may start with "-": pass --share-token <token>, or put the value after a "--" separator

password.description: share password when the share is password-protected. writeOnly: masked in --verbose / --dry-run body traces whether it arrives as a flag or through --data

target_space_id.description: destination drive space id; omit to use the caller's personal space

target_parent_id.description: destination folder id; ignored when target_space_id is omitted

name.description: name for the copy; defaults to the shared file's name

file_id.description: new drive node id, decimal string

get.summary: List copies of a shared blob the caller already holds
get.description: No share password is needed: the reply only covers the caller's own drive spaces in its verified Octo Space that hold the same stored object. Unknown, revoked or expired shares still fail (not_found / share_expired). An empty list means no copy.

parameters.name: share_token
parameters.description: share token parsed out of the share URL. base64url tokens may start with "-": pass --share-token <token>, or put the value after a "--" separator

get.summary: List recycle-bin entries the caller may see
get.description: scope=all (default without space_id) returns rows the caller deleted plus every tombstone in drive spaces the caller is super_admin of; scope=mine only the caller's own deletions; scope=space (default when space_id is set) every tombstone in one drive space and requires super_admin there. Paged by an opaque cursor; pass next_cursor back to continue.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: view: all, mine or space (the backend rejects anything else with invalid_argument); defaults to space when space_id is set, otherwise all

parameters.name: space_id
parameters.description: drive space id (personal:<octo-space>:<uid> or shared:<uuid>); required for scope=space

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: page size; values <= 0 use 50 and values above 100 are clamped to 100

id.description: tombstoned node id, decimal string; pass to trash restore / trash delete

parent_id.description: original parent folder id, decimal string

parent_alive.description: false means a restore lands at the space root

orig_path.description: original folder names from the space root

post.summary: Restore a recycle-bin entry
post.description: Allowed for the space's super_admin, or for the member who deleted it while still a member of the space. A folder restores with the subtree deleted in the same batch. When the original parent is gone the entry lands at the space root; a name clash gets a numeric suffix.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: tombstoned node id from trash list

parent_id.description: parent the node was restored under, decimal string

delete.description: Same permission as restore (space super_admin, or the deleter while still a member). Hard-deletes the tombstone and the subtree deleted in the same batch, then removes stored objects that no other row references. Cannot be undone.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: tombstoned node id from trash list

Role.description: drive space role. Grantability differs per surface: member add / member set-role accept preview_only, downloader, uploader_downloader, editor, admin and custom (custom is the lowest rank, below preview_only); invite create accepts the same set except custom, which carries no invite-link semantics. super_admin is never grantable through either — it is bound to the space creator at space creation. Granting admin is super_admin-only on both surfaces.

Page.description: shared page envelope. Drive v1 has no CLI auto-pagination; several endpoints return the full list alongside this envelope.

id.description: drive space id: personal:<octo-space>:<uid> or shared:<uuid>

octo_space_id.description: owning Octo Space tenant id — a different scope from id; never interchange them

name.description: display name resolved via octo-server; absent means fall back to uid

granted_by.description: uid that granted the role, or "system"

SearchResult.description: drive search response. items is this page's hits; total is a lower-bound estimate of the union count (name index + body index deduped), suitable for a 'N results' label but not an exact count.

total.description: lower-bound estimate of total matches across the caller's visible spaces

truncated.description: true when an internal cap (visible-doc set or an index page) was hit and some body hits may be missing

items.description: one search hit. file_id and parent_id are emitted as decimal strings (see x-octo-lossless-id-fields) because the backend uses uint64; size is a plain integer (files are capped well below 2^53). Display names for owner/updater/space are NOT included — resolve uid via octo-server the same way browse does.

file_id.description: unified drive node id, decimal string

space_id.description: drive space id the hit lives in

parent_id.description: immediate parent folder id, decimal string; "0" is the space root

path.description: breadcrumb of folder names from the space root to the immediate parent, exclusive of the item itself; [] for root-level hits

size.description: byte count; absent/0 for folders and docs. uint64 on the wire but files are capped well below 2^53, so it is emitted as a plain JSON number (not a lossless decimal string)

updater_uid.description: uid of last editor; empty string means never edited

content_meta.description: present on body hits: how the searched text was extracted

DriveEntry.description: unified file-tree node. id and parent_id are emitted as decimal strings (see x-octo-lossless-id-fields) because the backend uses uint64.

parent_id.description: parent folder id, decimal string; "0" is the space root

ref_type.description: underlying reference kind; present on some endpoints

ref_id.description: doc id for type=doc, object-storage key for type=blob

doc_space_id.description: type=doc only: the document's real Octo Space. Build document links from this — never substitute space_id, which is the drive space.

size.description: byte count; 0 for folders and documents

id.description: mount node id, decimal string. Use this for doc unmount — not doc_id.

doc_id.description: document id in the docs backend

doc_space_id.description: the document's real Octo Space id; absent on rows mounted before drive captured it

title.description: authoritative title read from the document metadata

space_id.description: the document's real Octo Space id

file_id.description: pending drive file id, decimal string

upload_mode.description: server-selected upload mode; the client must not request or override a mode

upload_url.description: presigned single-part PUT URL, present only for the single branch. Never send a caller credential to it or log it.

upload_id.description: object-storage multipart upload id, present only for the multipart branch; this is not a credential and cannot be used as a signature

part_size.description: server-computed part size in bytes for the multipart branch; the server has already converted KiB to bytes, so the client slices by bytes directly and must not convert again; the client must execute this value and must not override it

part_count.description: server-computed multipart part count, at most 10000; the client must not override it

max_concurrent_parts.description: server-recommended maximum concurrent parts; the client may be more conservative but must not exceed it

content_type.description: must be echoed as the PUT Content-Type

content_disposition.description: when present, must be echoed on the PUT verbatim

max_file_size.description: exact byte count the signature allows

Share.description: The backend returns one opaque `id` that is both the management handle and the access token. The CLI splits it into share_id (revoke) and share_token (access/download) via x-octo-response-fields so a future token rotation cannot silently break callers.

share_id.description: share record id; pass to share revoke

share_token.description: access token embedded in the share URL. Equal to share_id today — do not rely on that.

drive_file_id.description: shared drive file node id, decimal string

password_set.description: true when a password is required; the password itself is never returned

file_id.description: shared file node id, decimal string

ref_id.description: object-storage key; callers normally do not need it

existing_copies.description: best-effort hint: copies of the same blob the caller already holds in drive spaces of its current Octo Space. Omitted when there are none or the lookup failed.

file_id.description: drive node id of the caller's existing copy, decimal string

space_id.description: drive space id holding the copy

url.description: object-storage download URL, released only after this authenticated endpoint validated identity + token + password

Invite.description: invite_id and invite_token are deliberately distinct names: revoke takes the id, accept takes the token. The backend field names (id / token) are aliased by x-octo-response-fields.

invite_id.description: invite record id; pass to invite revoke

invite_token.description: invite token; pass to invite accept. Treat as a secret.

id.description: drive node id, decimal string; usable directly with file / download / share commands

idempotent.description: true when a pre-existing row was returned instead of a new one
